item.text: “I’m really enjoying having you here, and I love spending time together. I’ve realized I need a little quiet time each afternoon to recharge and take care of a few things. Would you mind giving me about an hour to myself around [time]? It’s not about you at all—I’m just someone who needs a bit of solitude to reset. Afterward, I’d be happy to hang out again or make plans together.”
